experiment: K17 full H x height x rotation x gripper source factorial

protocol.experiment: K17 height x rotation x gripper sources in both horizontal mean backgrounds
protocol.reference_strategy: reuse160 fully audited K16 episodes and their full400-step traces; rerun all4 references x2 actual queries at init20 as8 exact full-trace pilot audits before launching the rest. These audit repeats are not additional independent cases.
protocol.padding: all25 mean padding coordinates7:32 always from adapted model; amplified instruction response still coversall32
protocol.formula: at the same current observation, draft and flow time, compute mu_old/mu_new from canonical Left/Right; take mu_old only at selected H/Z/R/G coordinates, otherwise mu_new; add 2.959*(v_adapted(actual q)-mu_new), cast native dtype. Actual q forwarded directly; never choose an external target sign.
protocol.snapshots: same20 K14 Front-prefix stable-grasp snapshots20..39, exact signature/control replay/noise/global replan index; no outcome-based exclusions
protocol.gates: inits20,21,22, both actualq, all16 masks; selected coordinates bitwise equal all-old-executed HZRG output and all other coordinates equal N output; frozen K16 references match generalized formula; alpha0 removes actualq difference; N alpha1 native; finite32 dimensions and disjoint executed partition. Before full batch8 audit references at init20 must exactly match all400 trace steps.
primary_questions: for each H background, which Z/R/G addition is sufficient to improve Left/Right first/ever/terminal
which single removal from ZRG loses the full-combination recovery
whether component effects differ across H backgrounds and instructions
whether right-region arrival and actual placement require different combinations
readouts: L/R ever and terminal requested-goal success
paired split and total first correct
right-region book-center height above region upper bound
at identical initial physical input, first generated chunk cross-coordinate action differences under a single-source change, descriptive evidence of denoising coupling

statistics.unit: 20 physical snapshots, both q and all16 regimes resampled together
statistics.primary_contrasts: Z/R/G single additions and single removals from fullS in each H background, plus all32 conditional factor-switch edges
statistics.interactions: pairwise factor interactions with other factors fixed; unadjusted development screening
statistics.ranking: separate instruction/first/ever/terminal and H background; no universal scalar importance ranking; matched-complement removal and addition both reported
statistics.limits: no equivalence or familywise significance claim; reused states are not new confirmation data

interpretation_limits: normalized denoising coordinates, not independent semantic or physical modules
shared mean recomputed as x/obs change; effects may use cross-coordinate denoising or physical feedback
gripper magnitude is not gripping force
cannot identify training supervision/weight cause from output transplantation
same20 development states, one parent/adapted model pair, fixed gain/window
